experiment: Second-round correction reliability and robustness audit

robustness_matrix.evidence: Historical-support land-use rescue has non-zero, GIS-confirmed effects in Pihe, Shihe, and Hangbuhe, including both manual decline and increase cases.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: Regional evidence strength differs, so one hard threshold is not transferable.

robustness_matrix.evidence: All 3/3 regional candidates match direction under both retained manual-total scenarios.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: Pihe direction depends on combining upstream calibration with temporal rescue.

robustness_matrix.evidence: Most one-factor threshold variants retain direction; Pihe loses direction only under the strongest 1 ha minimum-area restriction.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: Large minimum-area or strict fill gates remove too much small-pond capacity.

robustness_matrix.evidence: Shihe and Hangbuhe improve under both manual scenarios; Pihe improves under source total but slightly worsens under component sum.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: Pihe shared-SAR upstream correction strongly underestimates 2025 absolute volume.

robustness_matrix.evidence: Pihe temporal rescue on original V75 matches direction=False, while shared-SAR plus rescue matches direction=True.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: The qualified Pihe trend is a module interaction and does not survive replacement by the original upstream baseline.

robustness_matrix.evidence: Held-out reviews repeatedly show real ponds among rescued objects and false positives among high-confidence groups; this validates both benefit and known side effects.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: Samples are mechanism checks rather than probability samples and cannot estimate accuracy.

robustness_matrix.evidence: Inputs exist for 19/21 pairs and 11 short-gap pairs, but the qualified chain is still centered on one target/manual pair.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: Season, rainfall, SAR acquisition geometry, optical cloud, and land-use timing may change the evidence behavior.

robustness_matrix.evidence: No production model, mask, or frozen parameter has been changed; manual data remain regional aggregates.
robustness_matrix.failure_condition: Object-level truth, multi-date validation, and bounded implementation are still missing.

decision_basis: Mechanisms replicate across three regions and opposite trend directions.
Direction is stable across retained manual-total scenarios and most local parameter perturbations.
Absolute volume, Pihe upstream dependence, and cross-date transfer remain the limiting dimensions.
GIS evidence confirms both true-water recovery and false-positive risk, so confidence evidence must remain auditable rather than become an unchecked hard gate.
required_before_production: Test at least two additional short-gap target dates spanning different observation conditions.
Preserve both manual-total scenarios until source discrepancies are resolved.
Implement upstream calibration and land-use rescue as separately switchable modules.
Evaluate object-level stratified samples or matched manual polygons when available.
